column2: ...I see. I don't know either...{wait}{clear}What she said, that the nobles set a trap for my brother and me, isn't hard to believe, but...{wait}{clear}...Damn it... I can't be sure of anything...{wait}{clear}And by the same token, I can't know that she didn't do it...{wait}{clear}
What I need to do now is fight the chaos.{wait}{clear}Once it's all over, I'll go back home...{wait}{clear}
Yeah, that's right.{wait}{clear}It's shaped after the royal crest. My brother wore the same one.{wait}{clear}
A long royal line... That's a world far away from mine...{wait}{clear}
Not really...{wait}{clear}Maybe you can't call us a normal family... But however you're born, the way you care about your family is the same.{wait}{clear}
Will you go where Savio went, Rudi?{wait}{clear}
Yeah, I'm going.{wait}{clear}
Be careful{n}
The armor...{n}
Please, be careful.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, I know how strong Savio is... When I fought him once, I couldn't lay a finger on him.{wait}{clear}But I'm not who I was back then... I'll win, and I'll break that curse.{wait}{clear}
His cursed armor was surely forged by the power of the demon world.{wait}{clear}
Seems that way.{wait}{clear}He said something about a mage...{wait}{clear}Demons, cursed armor... Maybe it's the mages' doings that are driving this world mad.{wait}{clear}
...I couldn't keep my promise to her.{wait}{clear}I'm... so pathetic...{wait}{clear}
You did your best{n}
The armor's curse...{n}
I think you did your best, Rudi...{wait}{clear}It was Savio's power and that curse... that brought about the tragedy...{wait}{clear}
If any more... people die like this...{wait}{clear}I...{wait}{clear}
Ngh... I have to keep fighting, don't I?{wait}{clear}Because that's the only thing I can do...{wait}{clear}
The armor's curse was powerful...{wait}{clear}The cause of this tragedy is someone, somewhere, who controls evil.{wait}{clear}
I... can't run away now...{wait}{clear}The enemy's still doing the same kind of thing, making lots of people suffer.{wait}{clear}I know that...{wait}{clear}But I...{wait}{clear}.....{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, are you there?{wait}{clear}Are you free right now? I mean, if you don't have time, that's fine...{wait}{clear}
Yes, that's fine...{wait}{clear}
Want to talk for a bit...?{wait}{clear}

...Hey... It's been a long time since we started traveling like this, huh?{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄... What have I even been doing all this time...?{wait}{clear}I couldn't... save anyone... I...{wait}{clear}I keep thinking... maybe I'm someone who can't do anything at all...{wait}{clear}
That isn't true...{n}
Do you regret it?{n}
That isn't true... Rudi...{wait}{clear}I don't think anything you've done so far was in vain, or that you were powerless...{wait}{clear}
No matter how much you tell me that, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, I just don't have the confidence...{wait}{clear}In the end, I lost everyone who mattered to me...{wait}{clear}

Rudi... Didn't you do everything you could, each and every time?{wait}{clear}And there are still... things we must do...{wait}{clear}I understand how you feel. The past is not easy to forget...{wait}{clear}But there is still... a future we must protect...{wait}{clear}
Do you regret what you've done so far?{wait}{clear}
It's not that... More than regret...{wait}{clear}
...I just can't bear it.{wait}{clear}How powerless I am...{wait}{clear}.....{wait}{clear}
...It's raining.{wait}{clear}

Whining in the rain, huh...{wait}{clear}Maybe my brother's angry... Telling me to quit saying pathetic things.{wait}{clear}My brother never once complained.{wait}{clear}The last time I saw him was the first time I heard it...{wait}{clear}To me, my brother was perfect... and yet...{wait}{clear}.....{wait}{clear}I often remember playing with him when we were little.{wait}{clear}He was good at everything... I loved tagging along after him.{wait}{clear}I can't... follow after my brother anymore...{wait}{clear}
Your brother's feelings...{n}
Even if it's painful...{n}
Your brother's feelings... his wish to save his country and its people... please cherish them too, Rudi.{wait}{clear}

Yeah, I know.{wait}{clear}...I have to go on alone now. As a man.{wait}{clear}I can't close my eyes or run away anymore...{wait}{clear}Because my brother never did...{wait}{clear}Thank you... ＄＄＄＄＄＄. For listening to me like this.{wait}{clear}I've finally sorted out how I feel...{wait}{clear}
Even if it's painful, time moves on. Hope lies only in the future...{wait}{clear}

Yeah... You're right.{wait}{clear}I have to protect what my brother was trying to protect.{wait}{clear}That's what I have to do...{wait}{clear}Sorry... for making you listen to me whine like this...{wait}{clear}But I've sorted out how I feel. I'll move forward... for the things I have to protect.{wait}{clear}
Not right now...{wait}{clear}
I see. Well, can't be helped... Some other time, then.{wait}{clear}
It's the Heavenly Dragon... ＄＄＄＄＄＄... You can see it from here too...{wait}{clear}
